results.title: Brace for the Storm
results.overview: While families gather on Mid-Autumn Eve, veteran employee Fang refuses to go home, leaving her stranded with a homesick Hong Kong student worker. When a typhoon strikes, this clashing pair must join forces through the tempestuous night to save their crumbling sanctuary.

results.title: Devilwoman
results.overview: A film director try to make a good film but then realized the arrangement from producer was awful, the leading actress is not what he wished, even the important prop on set was disappeared. Director wants to make arts but he only feels the pressure from the acclaimed executive producer KIN GEN HAO. Then devilwoman appears, she met someone she loves, but when everything seem so beautiful, she realized there's a big mistake.

results.title: Wildwood
results.overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

results.title: The Followers
results.overview: The animation depicts a renowned restaurant known for its mysterious cuisine, attracting visitors from around the world. Drawn by its reputation, the protagonist blindly follows the crowd to the restaurant. Eager to fit in, they even change their appearance to match social expectations. Upon realizing something is wrong inside, the protagonist becomes the target of everyone’s scrutiny. Unable to withstand the pressure of the crowd, and seeking the security of belonging, the protagonist denies their own perceptions—ignoring the stench of decay—and is transformed into a fly, willingly consuming the rotten food. This betrayal of reality represents the root of fear. Through this animation, we aim to encourage audiences to value independent thinking and the courage to question, prompting reflection on the importance of individuality and personal integrity.

results.title: Trapped
results.overview: After a lifetime under the control of his volatile mother, teenage Sam finds refuge in Claire, a childhood friend carrying wounds of her own. Their connection is immediate, deep, intense, and dangerously dependent. Believing that love will save them, they attempt to build a life of their own. But when the past refuses to stay buried, their bond twists into something far darker.

results.title: Cotswolds: Field & Folk
results.overview: A documentary film exploring farming, landscape and rural communities in the Cotswolds, following the changing seasons and the people who shape the land.  Through the voices of farmers, historians, conservationists, and local people, the film reveals how centuries of working the land have shaped the hills, fields, and villages we see today. As the seasons turn, it explores the challenges facing rural life - from changing farming practices to environmental pressures, while celebrating those who are working to care for the land and keep its traditions alive.

results.original_title: How to Draw a Flower For Beginners
results.overview: An experimental 16mm short film created by Maryada Rehling and Emmaline Zanelli, featuring their dog Billy. The images and sound were captured in and around Maslins in South Australia and the film was hand processed at Wombat Workshop, an Adelaide based community lab specialising in the processing of motion picture film. It premiered at the 2026 Adelaide Film Festival.
